description: Site of well known silver treasure hoard, deposited on the edge of the fen. Treasure has both Christian and Pagan symbolism present, and is within 15m of a Roman building which remains unexcavated. RSRB identifies this site as a 'shrine' because of the presence and probable association with the building. The date of the structure is unknown but the deposit is of the late 4th CE.
bibliography: Martyn, Blick, Brindle, and et al. “Mildenhall (Suffolk).” The Rural Settlement of Roman Britain: an online resource, 2015. https://doi.org/10.5284/1030449.
